codometer.description: Measure a project with codometer and write its report, from one process for every project Nx batches.

knip.description: Fail a project when knip reports an issue in its workspace, from one knip run for every project Nx batches.

spell-check.description: Fail a project when cspell finds a misspelling under its root, from one cspell run for every project Nx batches.
